newsitem.title: UK: UK government confirms plans for minimum wage.
newsitem.headline: UK government confirms plans for minimum wage.

text.p: The new Labour government confirmed plans on Wednesday to legislate for a statutory national minimum wage to promote fairness at work.

It said the wage would would be set according to the economic circumstances of the time and taking account of the advice of an independent Low Pay Commission, whose membership would include representatives of employers, small businesses and employees.
The Financial Times reported on Wednesday that the Commission would be headed by Peter Jarvis, who is due to step down next month as chief executive of brewing and leisure group Whitbread Plc.
A government spokeswoman called the report speculative and said no decisions about the composition of the commission had been taken yet.
